correctness.rationale: For |u|<pi, the locally convergent Mittag–Leffler series csc²u=u^(−2)+sum_{j≥0} b_j u^(2j) has b_j>0. Identity h3=−u³/2 d(csc²u)/du=1−sum_{j≥1} j b_j u^(2j+2) implies h3″<0; h0=cos u has h0″<0. At fixed u the logarithmic curvature h_t″/h_t=B″+t A″+(B′+t A′)² is a convex quadratic in t, hence lies below its endpoint maximum and remains strictly negative for every 0≤t≤3. Expansion h_t=1+(t−3)u²/6+O(u⁴) shows t>3 fails concavity near 0. The exact circle lift rho_t(theta) is proportional to h_t((pi−theta)/2) and has rho_t′(pi)=0; integration by parts twice gives negative moments −m^(−2) integral(−rho_t″)(1−cos m theta). Then the Schur algorithm preserves strictly negative Taylor coefficients and gives every Verblunsky parameter in (−1,0); the real-line paraorthogonal identity has all-positive coefficients and normalization sum 1. Endpoint t=3 is the concavity frontier only, not asserted to be positivity frontier. Finite symbolic checker is corroborative.
